items.headline: OpenAI cuts new funding round target by ~$10B to ~$20B amid AI-stock selloff, still eyes $1.25T valuation
items.why: Signals investor caution on AI financing pace even for the top lab; bridge round ahead of a planned 2027 IPO

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy-rate anchor to overnight repo rate, discloses it at 1.25%
items.why: Structural change to China's rate-setting framework, a signal of scope for further easing that matters for China growth and risk appetite

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM memory supply is already sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM scarcity extending another year, supporting pricing power for memory makers feeding AI chip demand

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: SK Hynix says DRAM and HBM supply is sold out through 2029 after record Q3; begins HBM4 mass production
items.why: Multi-year memory shortage is now the binding constraint on AI accelerator output, not GPU wafers

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4% at October FOMC; two governors dissent in favor of a hike
items.why: Hawkish dissent signals the Fed's easing path may be pausing, a risk factor for high-multiple AI equities

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom jointly put up $5B of equity in Meta's $95B AI-infrastructure capital raise
items.why: Chipmakers financing their own biggest customer underscores how circular AI capex funding has become

items.headline: AMD secures $20B+ commitment from Anthropic for MI450-based Helios AI systems, deliveries from 2027
items.why: Major proof point for AMD as a credible Nvidia alternative in frontier AI training/inference compute

items.headline: Broadcom arranges a $63B bank financing deal for Anthropic to buy more Broadcom AI chips via a special-purpose entity
items.why: Off-balance-sheet structure lets Anthropic scale custom AI chip buys without carrying the debt directly

items.headline: SpaceX secures $40B debt financing for GPU leasing; Meta seeks $95B AI infra financing — ~$235B single-day AI deal blitz
items.why: Scale of one-day AI infrastructure financing underscores how debt-funded the capex buildout has become

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO seeking up to $100B, discloses plans to spend up to $567B on compute
items.why: First look at Anthropic's real compute cost trajectory and balance sheet ahead of a landmark AI-sector listing

items.headline: Reuters: Anthropic investors told expected IPO valuation cut to ~$1.5T from ~$2T after growth slowed
items.why: First sign of AI-lab valuation compression even for a top-two foundation model company just before listing

items.headline: OpenAI nears $30B funding round at $1.25T valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue
items.why: Sets a new private-market valuation marker for the largest AI lab, down from the $1.4T figure discussed earlier
